(2) The nested AutonomousMode-owned InitialState->HighwayMode/UrbanMode edges exist and are triggered, satisfying NL2 endpoints, but the outer AutonomousMode->HighwayMode/UrbanMode dynamic-switch edges (NL11) are guarded by an internal route-token condition (R45RouteToken==22/23) rather than the stated high_way=true/urban_way=true guard directly, which is a wrong_guard/mismatched concern but is represented structurally by the same edges so left as satisfied at endpoint level; however the guard_disjointness for NL2 alternatives (InitialState->HighwayMode vs ->UrbanMode) is fine since triggers differ. (3) Event-consumer coverage for high_way_true/urban_way_true is broad and reachable, satisfying operational coverage. (4) No deadlock frontier fact indicates a genuine violation since all leaf-like states have all-event-consuming outgoing transitions. I focus candidates on the two termination contracts where target continuation reintroduces further behavior instead of stable completion.

(3) Event-consumer coverage for high_way_true/urban_way_true is broad and reachable, satisfying operational coverage. (4) No deadlock frontier fact indicates a genuine violation since all leaf-like states have all-event-consuming outgoing transitions.
